name: After Hours #37 — Polaroid Wall
description: A wall of nights already developed. The blinds slice the street into film stills. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 37 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 3-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
